sources.tor: open (country-level only — Onionoo dropped relay coordinates)

all.label: Everything in view
all.note: No type filter — every host Shodan has indexed in this area. Points are coloured by service category.

ics.label: ICS / SCADA
ics.note: Industrial control systems reachable from the public internet.

rdp.label: Exposed RDP
rdp.note: Remote Desktop endpoints — a top ransomware entry vector.

vnc.label: Unauthenticated VNC
vnc.note: VNC services advertising no authentication handshake.

databases.label: Open databases
databases.note: Document stores and caches answering on the open internet.

vulnerable.label: Known-CVE hosts
vulnerable.note: Hosts whose banners map to published CVEs.

iot.label: IoT / embedded
iot.note: Consumer and embedded devices with a public listener.

network.label: Network edge gear
network.note: Routers, firewalls and VPN concentrators at the network edge.

basemaps.label: Streets (OpenStreetMap)
basemaps.note: Street map. No key, no quota.

basemaps.label: Aerial (Cesium World Imagery)
basemaps.note: High resolution, but capture dates vary by years between regions. Use Sentinel-2 when you need to know how recent the picture is.

basemaps.label: Vector (OSM Shortbread)
basemaps.note: OpenStreetMap vector tiles drawn in the terminal palette. Rendered in the browser from the Shortbread schema via VersaTiles; no key, to zoom 14.

basemaps.label: Sentinel-2 (10 m)
basemaps.note: Recent Copernicus imagery via AWS Open Data. Pick a date window and a scene.

basemaps.label: Earth Engine composite
basemaps.note: Needs a Google service account — set GEE_* in .env.

atlas.label: RIPE Atlas probes
atlas.note: Volunteer network measurement probes, with ASN and connection type.

cell.label: Cell towers
cell.note: OpenCelliD: GSM/UMTS/LTE/NR cells with estimated position and range.

wigle.label: WiFi / Bluetooth
wigle.note: WiGLE wardriving survey. Free accounts are heavily rate-limited.

tor.label: Tor relays (by country)
tor.note: Onionoo stopped publishing per-relay coordinates, so this is country-level.

imagery.label: VIIRS night lights
imagery.note: Day/night band — city lights, gas flares, fishing fleets.

imagery.label: Thermal anomalies / fires
imagery.note: Detected heat sources, complements FIRMS points.

imagery.label: GOES-East GeoColor (clouds)
imagery.note: Near-real-time cloud cover over the Americas.

gdacs.label: GDACS alerts
gdacs.note: Global Disaster Alert & Coordination System — EU JRC / UN.

eonet.label: NASA EONET
eonet.note: Natural event tracker: storms, fires, ice, volcanoes.

usgs.label: USGS quakes
usgs.note: Every earthquake reported in the last 24 hours.

nws.label: NWS alerts
nws.note: US watches, warnings and advisories. Only ~15% carry polygons.
